A first stop before [Classic Synths Compared](synth-compare.qmd). Short sections, one idea each. Click a heading to fold or open it.

::: {.ik-do}
**What you'll do**

1. Read what the Voyager is and when it was made.
2. Learn its sound, one idea at a time.
3. Take a guided tour: press each **▶ Hear step** button and listen for one change.
4. Find records it is on.
5. Check yourself with a short quiz.
:::

## What it is

- The **Minimoog Voyager** was designed by **Robert Moog** and released by Moog Music in **2002** (Wikipedia, "Minimoog Voyager").
- It was meant as a successor to the [Model D](intro-model-d.qmd), and sold over 14,000 units before it stopped in 2015 (Wikipedia).
- This page follows the **Old School** version of 2008 (Wikipedia; Voyager Old School manual).

## Its sound

- **Three oscillators**, each with a wave knob that sweeps between shapes (Old School manual, PDF p. 6).
- **Two filters**: two low-pass filters side by side, or a high-pass and a low-pass in a row, with **Spacing** between them (manual, PDF p. 8).
- **Linear FM** lets oscillator 3 change oscillator 1's pitch very fast (manual, PDF p. 8).
- It plays one note at a time.

## The panel

This is the Voyager panel from [Classic Synths Compared](synth-compare.qmd), drawn after the real one (not a copy). Play it from the keys under the panel, the computer keys (a w s e d f t g y h u j k) or a MIDI keyboard. Turn any knob while you play. The sound is this site's own model; nobody has compared it with the real instrument.

## Guided tour

Each step loads a worked example and changes one thing.

```{=html}
<div class="ik-step" data-ex="voyager-hplp" data-set="{&quot;mode&quot;:&quot;dual&quot;,&quot;space&quot;:0}"><p><b>Dual low-pass.</b> Two low-pass filters together. Listen: a warm lead.</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-ex="voyager-hplp"><p><b>HP/LP with Spacing.</b> High-pass then low-pass, spaced apart. Listen: a thinner band in the middle.</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-ex="voyager-hplp" data-set="{&quot;space&quot;:3}"><p><b>More Spacing.</b> Listen: the band gets wider.</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-ex="voyager-fm" data-set="{&quot;linFm&quot;:false}"><p><b>One oscillator.</b> Linear FM off. Listen: a plain tone.</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-ex="voyager-fm"><p><b>Linear FM on.</b> Oscillator 3 modulates oscillator 1. Listen: a bright, bell-like tone.</p></div>
```
